assets.style: Painterly cinematic illustration, mystical and dramatic, deep violet and indigo night with radiant gold light, high contrast, vertical 9:16 composition with one clear subject in the center, no text, no letters, no watermark.
images: four glowing golden vertical lines of light standing like a doorway in a dark starry void, a tiny person in front of it
an old clock face glowing at eleven eleven in a dark room, light rays from the clock
a hand knocking on a huge ancient door made of stars, golden light leaking through the cracks
a woman with closed eyes and a peaceful face, golden light and tiny stars swirling around her head

animate.motion: the four lines of light pulse and grow brighter, sparks drift upward, the doorway slowly opens with light

voices.name: l00
voices.text: 이 영상이 지금 보였다면, <#0.3#> 우연이 아닐 수도 있어요.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: 영적인 전통에서는 이걸, <#0.2#> 우주가 문을 두드리는 신호라고 불러요.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: 이 숫자를 본 순간 떠올린 생각이, <#0.2#> 현실로 이어지기 시작한다고요.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: 그래서 대부분의 사람들은, <#0.2#> 이 순간을 걱정하면서 흘려보내요.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: 지금 3초만 눈을 감고, 원하는 걸 떠올리세요. <#0.4#> 하나. <#0.6#> 둘. <#0.6#> 셋.

voices.name: l06
voices.text: 방금 떠올린 그거, <#0.2#> 댓글로 남겨 두세요.
